title: A principal localization of a one-dimensional local domain is its fraction field
statement: Let B be a local integral domain of Krull dimension 1 [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], let K=Frac(B) be its fraction field, and let 0\ne f belong to the maximal ideal of B. Let B_f denote the localization away from f [def-weil-ring-localization-away]. Then the localization map B_f\to K is an isomorphism.
